result.summary: A dark-themed SoundShared broadcast console is shown in a 1378×790 screenshot. The left panel contains a sound library, a group and category rail, four sound rows, and master output controls. The right panel shows a stopped network server, listener information, and configuration. Most controls align cleanly, but a button beside START SERVER extends beyond the right panel and is clipped by the image edge. Faint content is also cut off along the bottom edge.

semantics.intent: Manage sound clips and their playback levels, configure a network server, and monitor broadcast and listener status.

visual.style: Compact dark desktop dashboard with thin borders, monospaced uppercase metadata, red accent buttons and selection markers, and horizontally arranged audio controls.
notes: The library occupies approximately x=0–967; the network panel occupies x=997–1339, leaving a dark gap between them.
The selected All Sounds row has a red left border; the group rail appears correctly rendered.
Four uniform sound cards occupy the central area of the library panel.
The secondary button beside START SERVER overflows the network panel and is visibly clipped at the right image boundary.
Faint, partially cut-off content is visible at the very bottom.

uncertainty: Only “COPY LI” is legible on the clipped button; its full label cannot be confirmed.
The tiny square icons at the ends of track rows and beside LISTEN URL are visible, but their functions cannot be determined from the image.
The faint content below the bottom status bar is too clipped and low-contrast to transcribe reliably.
The dash inside the LISTEN URL field may be a short hyphen rather than an em dash.
